notes.title: SUMMER DEV UPDATE
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/09acdaf46b5370f05c9f66f87849f1e7b931d77e.png"][/img][/p][h1][u][b]Hello Citizens![/b][/u][/h1][p]Sebastian here![/p][p][/p][p][u][i]Sadly summer is almost over… but our [b]Summer Dev Update[/b] is here![/i][/u][i] [/i][/p][p]It’s been a few busy months, and we've been heads-down building some of the most requested features and improvements for [b]City20[/b].[/p][p]We are going to take a look back at everything we've been cooking that you will be able to play in [b]our next patch[/b]! And maybe a little glimpse into what's coming next, who knows![/p][p][i][b]That said, let's get right into it![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/f8ad97d69cb9bc9332d3452e3623a2bd3317c386.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We've focused on introducing a whole new layer of social behavior to make your interactions with NPCs more dynamic and believable.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/c217d93acf47a3dd579a3cda82720c3ef1ada791.png"][/img][u][b]Even More NPCs Reactions[/b][/u][b] [/b][/h3][p]If you ask an NPC where someone is and they're nearby, that NPC will actually come to you. And if you knock on a door and a roommate answers, you will be able to ask them to fetch the person you're looking for, if they are at home at the moment.
[/p][h3][u][b]Quest Givers[/b][/u][/h3][p]NPCs will proactively approach you to deliver important messages, like telling you that another NPC is looking for you and wants to give you a quest.[/p][p][i]The NPC were tired of waiting, they are eager to have a chat with you!
[/i][/p][h3][u][b]NPC Biographies[/b][/u][/h3][p]You will be able to keep track of your history with each NPC, directly from the talk UI or in the Society Tab. This log will help you remember past interactions and what you’ve done together. [/p][p][i]Quite useful after loading your game after a long time!
[/i][/p][h3][u][b]Easier Escorts and Visual Cues[/b][/u][/h3][p]No more trying to awkwardly match an NPC’s walking pace! With the help of a button, you will be able to automatically follow the NPC who is escorting you somewhere, making quests and navigation much smoother.[/p][p]When an NPC talks about an object or a location, they will point to it, giving you a clear visual clue about what they're talking about.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/b9bb788bef2dd1ea01d22fa0022d9f43feea319c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/5e537e9dc099e1f4d566dec160d057f992b442c9.png"][/img][/p][p][i]You asked for more [b]QoL[/b] features and we listened! This is just the beginning of the many improvements we will add to make your time in [b]City20[/b] more enjoyable - leaving aside the mood of the city…[/i][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/adca012c207273246af49500b15ba00deb32a08b.png"][/img][u][b]Save Anywhere you Want[/b][/u][/h3][p]We will be introducing the ability to sleep on benches and sofas, which means you can now save your game anywhere without the need for a bed. You can also rest on them - and chairs too! You can skip time without the need to be eepy! ZZzzz
[/p][h3][b][u]No more Littering![/u][/b][/h3][p]NPCs will collect items you drop on the ground after roughly one day has passed. Additionally, dead NPCs will now decompose and disappear after 3-4 days, keeping the city cleaner, with the addition of a few bones… even though the end result will be less calcium-heavy!
[/p][h3][u][b]Clearer UIs[/b][/u][/h3][p]We’ve made some key improvements to the UI to help you manage your time and tasks. Now, you’ll get clearer feedback on [b]shop closing times[/b], so you can keep an eye on the clock and avoid getting abruptly kicked out.[/p][p]Also, we’ve revamped the diary notes, which will include more detailed information for the quests: [/p][list][*][p]Progress percentage[/p][/*][*][p]Deadline Countdown[/p][/*][*][p]Reward Preview[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that these changes will help you stay on top of your tasks!
[/p][h3][u][b]More Books! More Dynamic![/b][/u][/h3][p]Twelve types of blueprint manuals have been printed, with many volumes scattered throughout the city.
Each one dynamically unlocks a random recipe related to its subject, offering a fresh experience with every new game. To assist in their discovery, bookshelves will visually indicate the presence of books as you approach them.[/p][p]Find them all, unlocking blueprints could never get any easier!
[/p][h3][u][b]BACKPACKS ARE HERE!!![/b][/u][/h3][p]That's right, the most requested feature will finally be here! Back up your inventory with a brand new backpack! Explore the map to find it or buy it now from Mozga's Emporium!!! This is not a sponsored bit but hey - Mozga… I’m always a call away.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/9153d95b34fe4ccf7747e4ccf517749ffaab31fe.png"][/img][/p][p][i]While the city's complex simulations are quite CPU-heavy, we're constantly working to make the game lighter and more accessible for everyone. [b]We hear you, Steam Deck users![/b][/i][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/5b29e5ce7b3342f8378bf00cc9677388dc77aa98.png"][/img][u][b]More Accessible[/b][/u][/h3][p]A scale for the HUD/UI will be added to make everything more readable, and capped the graphics settings to ensure a smooth experience on smaller screens.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/b62d225a74bd7de53767034114364180f4f64b45.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We've also been hard at work squashing the bugs you've reported over the past few months. Thank you for your continued help and patience! We are committed to providing the most stable experience possible.
[/i][/p][p]Aaaand with that, our Summer Dev Update comes to an end...
...but wait, are you still here? 

We like your dedication! As a reward for sticking with us, here's a little sneak peek at our next major update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/2b20518fcc0795e13327785c7eb9677021c57c28.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We are already preparing the next major update, working on new intricate systems and testing how the city will react to them. This is just the beginning…[/i] [b]City20 is about to get a lot more dangerous.[/b][/p][p]Get ready for [b]new quests[/b], deeper [b]lore[/b], and a [b]new threat[/b] that will change everything! [/p][p]Surprise surprise: [b]Enemies are coming![/b] Find the [b]secrets buried[/b] in the first version of our new [b]bunkers[/b], with more [b]areas[/b] to [b]explore[/b] and new [b]challenges[/b] to overcome.
[/p][h3][u]We are going to change the city and its citizens forever.[/u][/h3][p]Stay tuned for our next update, and thank you for your incredible support! [/p][p][i][b]See you at our next Monthly Dev Update![/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.2 is Out!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Citizens, 

We just finished cooking a new hotfix for City 20! The patch tackles some of the most recent bugs you reported here on Steam and a few issues with the game that resurfaced after the launch of our latest major milestone update! Take a look at the full changelog below![/p][p][i][b]0.6.2 Hotfix[/b][/i] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a rendering issue that caused black artifacts and shadows on modern AMD GPUs (7000 series). This should remove any black spots or squares for AMD users;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hare carcasses could not be skinned when placed on the ground by the player;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would crash when consuming a StamiPill;[/p][/*][/list][p]The patch is already live and ready to download. If the game doesn't update automatically, try restarting your Steam client.  [/p][p]As usual, don't forget to join our Discord to get the latest on the development of City 20 - including new features we're working on, gameplay suggestions, beta-testing sessions and much more![/p][p]See you on the next one![/p]

notes.title: Roadmap Milestone - The Lights of Tomorrow Update is Out NOW!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]Rise and shine, City 20 just received its biggest early access update to date! [/p][p][/p][p]As we mentioned and teased over the past few weeks, Our [i]Lights of Tomorrow [/i]update brings some major changes to the world of City 20 - from a slew of new content for you to enjoy to improved systems and mechanics that help the game feel more realistic and alive! The update also helps us lay the foundations for what's to come, a glimpse of which you'll get at the end of this post! [/p][p][/p][p]But what exactly can you expect the next time you jump into the game? [i]Lights of Tomorrow [/i]was designed for both newcomers and veteran players, so there's new things for everyone! Get ready to walk your first steps in the city as you explore our [b]brand new tutorial and starting area[/b]. And then meet [b]new NPCs[/b] (including a now canonically bald Goga), test your skills with [b]new quests and missions[/b], learn more about the [b]mystery surrounding the city[/b], master [b]new gameplay systems and mechanics[/b], and much more![/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Lights of Tomorrow [/b][/i][b]Update - Full Changelog[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Your first 30 minutes with the game[/i][/p][list][*][p]Enjoy a brand-new intro cutscene which sheds some light on your character's background; [/p][/*][*][p]Explore a reworked starting area, with more missions and a step-by-step tutorial to ease you into the world of City 20;[/p][/*][*][p]Meet a new version of Goga - now a lot less clingy and canonically bald![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i]A whole lot of new gameplay mechanics and systems[/i][/p][list][*][p]The in-game maps now gets updated automatically as you visit new locations, with scribbles and hand-written notes to show where you've been and what you found;[/p][/*][*][p]City-wide power nodes now let you restore, distribute and control electricity for entire parts of the city - which you can then harness for your own schemes;[/p][/*][*][p]Faction-specific bulletin boards have been added back into the game! Use them to find additional missions to complete to earn more money and boost your relationship with a specific faction; [/p][/*][*][p]Combat is now a lot more fluid, with swings, hits, and parries chaining to create a more dynamic exchange - especially when fighting multiple enemies at once;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i]A more realistic world to explore[/i][/p][list][*][p]Meet a new cast of NPCs, each with their unique routines, quirks, needs, and roles within the city's post-nuclear society;[/p][/*][*][p]Discover new areas, including new buildings to explore and a brand new mini-settlement outside the Raboch's sector;[/p][/*][*][p]Walk around the city and witness more realistic conversations between the inhabitants, as we keep working on our dynamic dialogue improvements; [/p][/*][*][p]Spot and collect new items, new tools, and additional bits of lore as you explore;[/p][/*][*][p]Keep an ear out for improved sound effects, which will get even better with the next updates;  [/p][/*][*][p]We added signage to the world, which should make it a bit easier to find key points of interest![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Bits, bobs & other technical stuff[/i][/p][list][*][p]We've restyled some of the in-game UIs, and we're working to make them even more beautiful;[/p][/*][*][p]We're laying the foundation for a new progression system, which will let you track progress across each game you play; [/p][/*][*][p]The game should now behave correctly when played on ultrawide resolution and monitors; [/p][/*][*][p][b]City 20 now supports Steam Cloud Saves![/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT SAVES-RELATED INFO:[/b]
As with any other time we've added new content to the game, because of the way saves work, this patch WON'T allow you to keep loading your old saves. That said, you can still keep playing your old games if you so desire.

To do so, you will have to access a specific version of the game on Steam, which won't include the update but will remain compatible with your older saves. Below is a quick step-by-step guide for it.
[/p][list][*][p]From your Steam library, right click on City 20 and open the "properties" panel;[/p][/*][*][p]In the properties window, head to the menu on your left and open the "Betas" tab;[/p][/*][*][p]Next, locate the Beta Participation section and click the downward blue arrow to reveal your Beta options;[/p][/*][*][p]Locate and select the "0.5.2" Beta Branch, which includes the older version of the game;[/p][/*][*][p]Your copy of City 20 will now update. If everything went well, the game should now be labeled as "City 20 \[0.5.2] in your library.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next For City 20?[/h2][p][i]Lights of Tomorrow [/i]was a true milestone for us, but the game is still far from done! Over the next few months, we'll be working on adding even more content, mechanics, NPCs, items, and storylines! Want to get a glimpse at what we're working on next? Well, there you go! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/78d9296c21ffcb855128fee4fe5f7a2a03261578.png"][/img][/p][p]As usual, you should join our community if you want to know more about the future of City 20! Don't forget to follow us on social media and hop on our Discord to get the latest news, previews, and sneak peeks into the game!

Enjoy the update and see you on the next one![/p]

notes.title: Lights Of Tomorrow update Is Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Citizens! [/p][p]We teased this for a while, now it's time to make it official! Our next major early access update, which our full team worked on over the past few months, is finally [b]going live next week[/b]![/p][p]The [i]Lights of Tomorrow[/i] update focuses on improving the first few hours you'll spend in CITY 20, while also laying the foundation for future updates we have planned for the upcoming months. It is our way to show you that we remain committed to the original vision we had for the game, while also acting on the feedback, support and suggestions you shared with us over the last 9 months. [/p][p]Consider it a major milestone in the development of City 20, but also a platform from which to jump even higher![/p][h2]A City That Keeps Changing[/h2][p]While we won't share a full changelog for the update until next week, we do want to give you a taste of what you can expect when [i]Lights of Tomorrow [/i]goes live on July 14th. Alongside delivering a long list of technical improvements, the update aims to give both newcomers and veterans of City 20 a reason to jump back in. [/p][p]From the very first minutes, you'll notice how much the city has changed. There's a new lore-rich tutorial waiting for you and a brand new cutscene that sheds a bit of light on where you really come from. The starting area and some of the city's outskirts have also changed and are now inhabited by a new set of colorful characters - not all of whom might be so open to a stranger walking among them! [/p][p]We have also added something for returning players, with new areas to explore and a revamped dynamic map system. You'll now be able to see your location on the map regardless of the gadgets you have equipped and the map itself will update with notes, scribblings, and drawings as you explore to help you find your place in the world. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/a4c73f10602b89882ceb0c1af405fb4eb79205b9.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Power To The Masses [/h2][p][i]Lights of Tomorrow [/i]also expands on our already existing electrical power system. We're introducing a new power nodes mechanic and putting electricity back in the hands of the people! Puns aside, this gives you control over electricity for entire sections of the city, with the chance to restore power and use light (or darkness) to your advantage.[/p][p]Speaking of masses, we're also reworking the way NPCs act, interact, and play a role within the game. Expect to come across more than a few new NPCs - each with their unique routine, needs, and quirks. The other citizens are also going to be more talkative and will be more likely to approach you with a request or to voice their concerns - especially once you gain their trust. [/p][p]And finally, by popular demand, vendors have now been authorized to buy your junk off of you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/1e9e6ff6fc94851aeb8de0fe9b5f3c73d344cb11.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]All In A Day's Work[/h2][p]This update couldn't be complete with something to do for the most experienced of city dwellers. Once you're done exploring, building your home, and finding the truth about the incident, you can now decide to support the community![/p][p][i]Lights of Tomorrow[/i] reintroduces faction-specific bulletin boards, where members of each faction can ask for help with various kinds of tasks. If you feel inclined to lend a hand, just head to the boards and pick your next task. If just doing a good deed isn't enough, know that there's always going to be some money and a bit of reputation to gain from completing the missions![/p][p]Not the most friendly of types? No worries! Alongside the rest, the update also includes the first version of our revamped combat system. We're sure you'll love it as you try alternative ways to settle your disputes with the rest of the city's inhabitants![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/09b62e5ae547751cc292c2c837ee5e4fb1a7a408.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [i]Lights of Tomorrow[/i] update comes out next Monday, on July 14th, 2025! In the meantime, don't forget to join our Discord to stay up to date with the latest news from the development of City 20!
[/p][p]See you on the next one![/p]

notes.title: June Development Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Citizens, 

June is now squarely behind us and it's time for another recap of what the team's been up to in the past four or so weeks! 

Despite being a pretty busy month, June was mostly dedicated to making City 20 more stable and preparing for our next major early access update. We focused on fixing some of the bugs you reported on our Discord, tweaked a ton of things under the hood and laid the groundwork for the update itself - which will be [b]out later this month[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Nevertheless, we still managed to finalize our new map system - which we hope will make it easier for you to navigate the world of City 20![/p][p][/p][h2]Scribbles, Notes and Dynamic Updates[/h2][p]Just like the rest of the world, the map will now adapt to your actions in the game! As you keep exploring the city, you'll see new notes and scribbles appear on the map to mark the locations you have already walked through. Points of interest, important locations and your current position will also be marked on the map, so that it's easier for you to find your bearings![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/a4c73f10602b89882ceb0c1af405fb4eb79205b9.jpg"][/img]The new map will already be available with our next update and you'll be able to check it out when the patch is published later in July. Don't miss it![/p][p][/p][p]As usual, don't forget to join our Discord and follow us on social media to get the latest on the development of City 20![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the next one![/p]

notes.title: May Development Update & Community Playtesting!
notes.notes:
Hey Citizens!

With the month coming to an end, we’re back with a fresh round of updates on what we worked on for City 20! 

Over the last few weeks, we focused on improving world navigation, deepening faction mechanics, and refining your overall experience. There’s also a new cutscene to kick off your adventure with a bit more flair in the works, and work continues on the combat system, new additions and bug fixing!

But enough beating around the bush, let’s take a look at what’s cooking behind the scenes:

[h2]A more immersive world[/h2]
Our artists focused on some of the storefronts in the game, which will have a visual refresh to better reflect the identity of each business. We're also making navigating the world a bit easier, with directional signs to help guide you to key locations and landmarks! A revamped map will also update dynamically as you explore the world - removing the need for guesswork!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/daed860f20714aa6705ba36d49cb3cc0127e6211.jpg[/img]
[h2]Progression & Gameplay[/h2]
With the upcoming updates, you'll finally be able to get new requests from factions. Completing them earns you Reputation and unlocks more opportunities. Faction-Exclusive areas are also being worked on, but you'll need a high-enough reputation with the right group to access them. Finally, shops will start accepting to buy your gathered materials and resources - which will make it a bit easier to earn money in the game!
[h2]UX & Tech[/h2]
There's some news on the tech side of things as well! Soon, the game will also properly support ultrawide resolutions! We also continue working on fixing bugs and making the experience more enjoyable for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/254ef2b4e713064024033be803eaa0830f1aec10.png[/img]
Alongside our usual updates, over the next few weeks we're looking to get a couple of community playtesting sessions started! We'll be selecting some of our community members and give you access to special builds of the game, where you'll be able to test and give feedback on some of the new, super-special features we're working on! 

The playtesting is open to anyone who already owns the game! If you're interested in joining in, simply fill out this form [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6AiKxzHyKwBiOCFdFKWBOcb95CLU4DxevGm_QpsquOIgtjw/viewform]right here[/url]. We'll try to go through everyone that applies, so if you're not picked right away, don't worry! Your time will come!

As usual, don't forget to join our Discord and follow us on social media to get the latest on the development of City 20!

See you on the next one!

notes.title: April Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey Citizens!

It's the end of the month and, as usual, it's time to pull back the curtain on what the team worked on over the past four weeks - as well as what's coming next for City 20!

After the two hotfixes we dropped over the first week of April, we were able to focus on new content for our next major milestone. The update should be coming in the next couple of months - more news on that soon - and will bring major changes to the game. Let's see what you can expect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/0e6c6d299b9785f6403ca34e38ad542a6d7b1d43.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Brand New Combat System![/h2]
After getting feedback from a lot of our players, we decided to rework the way you can fight your enemies in the game! 

Over the past few months, we've been redesigning our combat system from scratch, focusing on making combat in City 20 more dynamic, intuitive and fun! While this is a work in progress, a first version of the new system will already be available with our next update - with further fine-tuning and improvements planned for the future! 

[h2]New NPC Traits and Behaviors[/h2] 
Our goal has always been for City 20 to feel alive and realistic, which is why we've been working on adding more unique NPCs to the game. Among these, you can expect to run into henchmen that will try to extort money out of you, hunters stalking their preys and even herbalists growing plants to make medicine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/1e9e6ff6fc94851aeb8de0fe9b5f3c73d344cb11.jpg[/img]

[h2]Electrical Shelters, Bulletin Boards and Improved Settlements[/h2]
The factions in City 20 never rest and neither did we. For the next update, we're working on a number of new props, models, and animations - which will all contribute to how the city looks and feels to explore. 

In addition to that, we're also working on restoring Bulletin boards - from where you'll be able to accept special quests from various NPCs for extra Pamyat! Electrical Shelters will also make an appearance throughout the city in the near future, each containing a node you can repair to restore power!

[h2]An Improved Tutorial and a New Goga[/h2]
Finally, we're also aiming to make getting into City 20 easier for everyone! The team's working on a new starting area, which will also shed additional light on the protagonist's lore and background. And while Goga will still be the first human you'll meet in City 20, we're also reworking his behavior and the way he'll interact with you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/65d135d956d76e489f7b3cd8d0fb5c97538e150d.jpg[/img]

And that's just the beginning! A lot more changes are coming to City 20 soon! If you want to keep up with what we're doing, don't forget to follow us on social media and join our Discord!

As usual, see you on the next one!

notes.title: 0.5.2 Hotfix is out!
0.5.1 Hotfix & Multiple Saves System
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!

As we mentioned a few days ago, these past few weeks we've been hard at work to fix several new bugs introduced with the recent Radiation Update!

Here is a full list of the issues the current patch addresses:

[i]NPCs and Characters[/i]
[list]
[*]NPCs will no longer introduce themselves at inappropriate moments (e.g., while the players are trespassing, committing a crime, or near a dead/fainted NPC).
[*]We kindly asked NPCs to stop trying to speak to the players at the same time.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when NPCs interact with multi-NPC relaxation areas (e.g., tables) under certain conditions.
[*] Vomiting and coughing caused by radiation no longer stops as soon as the player gains the "radioactive" status.
[*]The stamina bonus effect from equipping the Exolegs should now apply correctly.
[*] Wearing hazmat pants now correctly counts as wearing pants.
[/list]
[i]Quests and Progression[/i]
[list]
[*]Solved an issue that caused players to get stuck in counter-offer dialogues during beating quests.
[*]Fixed a soft-lock that happened after failing the gasoline quest in certain conditions.
[/list]
[i]UI and Miscellaneous[/i]
[list]
[*]Your first Apartment Key is no longer removed when purchasing a second apartment.
[*]Fixed a number of navigation actions in various menus.
[*]Fixed advanced furniture UIs to work as intended.
[*] Picked up containers now correctly show the name of the substance they contain.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when switching between the map and the NPC List.
[*] Trees no longer spawn overlapping each other.
[*] The Geiger Counter sound is now working as expected.
[/list]
[i]Known Issues[/i]
[list]
[*]Missing gamepad prompt icons on game launch. To resolve this, simply make any change in the settings and save. The issue will not occur in future sessions.
[/list]
A number of other smaller smaller issues have also been addressed.

[h3]Multiple Saves System[/h3]
Following your requests for more freedom to experiment, the hotfix also introduces a reworked saves system. City 20 now automatically keeps the last 5 saves for each playthrough, allowing you to restore previous versions of your progress.

In order to load any of the previous saves, simply head to the "continue" or "load game" menus and select the game you'd like to load. You'll see up to five different saves, each labeled and tagged according to the in-game date and real-world time they were saved. 

Enjoy City 20 and, as usual, don't forget to join our Discord to keep contributing to the development of the game!

See you on the next one!

notes.title: March Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey Citizens!

As we leave March behind, it's time for another update on what the team at Untold Games has been working on! A lot has happened in the past 30 or so days and we have a ton of news to share with you! So let's get started!

[h2]A slew of hotfixes on the way![/h2]
March marked our biggest milestone yet, with version 0.5.0 introducing the brand new Radiation mechanics, a new way to acquire and learn blueprints, new areas to explore, vendors, NPCs, and much more! 

Of course, as with any major update, a couple of bugs have slipped through the nets. Alongside our amazing community (yep, that's you! <3) we worked tirelessly on finding and squashing as many issues as we could! We'll be deploying a new patch in the next couple of days, which addresses a lot of the problems you reported in the last month! 

Keep an eye out for it! 

[h2]New Multiple Saves Support[/h2]
You know we're always working to make City 20 more fun and exciting to play! Alongside the fixes, the patch we just mentioned expands City 20's saves system!

With the new system, you will have up to five game slots to choose from - two more than the three that you are currently used to. Alongside that, each save slot now lets you access your last five saves for that game - allowing you to create multiple "backups" of your adventure and always have somewhere to fall back to as you keep playing. 

Let's be clear, this is absolutely, 100%, cross my heart NOT designed so you could go on a rampage! ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/e427f97f3cae53eadfcc43620c8e17693f66547b.png[/img]

[h2]City 20 is still growing![/h2]
Alongside stability and [i]quality of life[/i] updates, we're also working on improving City 20 all around! Over the next couple of months, we'll be reshaping some sections of the game - making it easier for both newcomers and City 20 veterans to find their way in our dystopian world! 

While we can't share too much about it yet, you should once again keep an eye out for updates! Don't forget that joining our Discord is the easiest way to get exclusive previews, participate in beta-testing, and contributing to the evolution of City 20!

See you on the next one!

notes.title: Roadmap Milestone - Radiation Update
notes.notes:
Hello citizens! 

As you might have heard on social media and Discord, City 20 is getting irradiated! Version 0.5.0 brings a slew of changes to the game! 

For those looking for a new adventure, [b]prepare to explore the LINAC[/b] - a mysterious abandoned research facility with an eerie backstory. Visit the complex's surroundings, deal with the huge amount of radiation that makes the land inhabitable, and do your best to discover what lies beneath its concrete walls. Rumors have it that unspeakable experiments were conducted there before the incident, so be ready for anything! 

But that's not all! We heard your requests for more ways to learn and discover things in the game, which is why the update also introduces readable recipes and blueprints. And then lore notes, a new Doctor NPC, a wider selection of items available in stores, and much more! 

[b]Radiation update - Full Changelog [/b]

[i]Radiation System[/i]
[list]
[*] Visit the LINAC, a new playable area with explorable buildings.
[*] Learn to deal with the "Radiation" status effect,  which progressively impacts the player as your exposure increases.
[*] Discover and craft new items to counter radiation exposure, including  a Geiger counter and hazmat suit.
[/list]
[i]Documents & Books[/i]
[list]
[*] New documents revealing lore elements of City 20 have been scattered throughout the map. Find them all!
[*] You can now unlock blueprints and recipes from books.
[/list]
[i]Stores and NPCs[/i]
[list]
[*] Meet a new NPC: the Doctor. They will come in handy when your limbs start falling apart from radiation!
[*] We have expanded the Mozga Emporium to offer a wider selection of items!
[/list]
[i]Food & Economy[/i]
We rebalanced some of the food effects to make gameplay more interesting;
We tweaked the prices and values for some of the resources;

[i]Tech & Misc[/i]
[list]
[*] City 20 now supports AMD FSR 3.1 and NVIDIA DLSS 3.7;
[*] You can now choose controller glyphs from your favourite console in the options menu;
[/list]
[i]Known Issues[/i]
[list]
[*] Missing gamepad prompt icons on game launch. To resolve this, simply make any change in the settings and save. The issue will not occur in future sessions.
[*] Beating Quest: Some branching paths still have unresolved bugs.
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT SAVES-RELATED INFO:[/b]
Because of the way the update works, this patch WON'T allow you to keep loading your old saves. That said, we want to give everyone the chance to keep playing your old games if you so desire.

To do so, you will have to access a specific version of the game on Steam, which won't include the December update but will remain compatible with your older saves. Below is a quick step-by-step guide for it.
[list]
[*]  From your Steam library, right click on City 20 and open the "properties" panel;
[*]  In the properties window, head to the menu on your left and open the "Betas" tab;
[*]  Next, locate the Beta Participation section and click the downward blue arrow to reveal your Beta options;
[*] Locate and select the "0.4.1" Beta Branch, which includes the older version of the game;
[*] Your copy of City 20 will now update. If everything went well, the game should now be labeled as "City 20 [0.4.1] in your library.
[/list]

[b]CITY 20 Community Streams[/b]
To celebrate our major milestone, we're also hosting our first CITY 20 Community Stream! Join us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/untoldgamestv]Twitch[/url] tomorrow, on March 12th @ 5PM CET and let's play some of the new content together!

notes.title: February Development Update & Women's Day Sales
notes.notes:
Hey Citizens!

We come bearing NEWS! To give you a better view on the future of City 20, we decided to start a series of monthly dev logs. Every 30 or so days, you'll get a glimpse into what our team accomplished and what you can expect from the near future!

So what did we work on in February? Quite a bit, actually! 

[h2]Radiations System[/h2]
One of the biggest changes to the game so far, our next update will include a brand new radiations system. While we'll share more details about it in the near future, know that City 20 is getting irradiated soon. This will mean new areas to explore, a new "irradiated" status you'll need to deal with and new items to craft to fend off radiations! 

The radiations system also introduces a new potential job for members of the Mozga faction - they can now be Doctors! As you might have seen on our social media, doctors will be able to heal the effects of radiations, give you more information about your character's health and sell medicine! We're also adding new interiors for the Doctor's office, which will look somewhat like this below!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/3bd0256a92e0a9abe5115e535fb3eb012ddcdd31.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Blueprints, Lore and Items[/h2]
We heard your requests and have come up with an easier way to learn new blueprints - all without having to deal with or befriend people. So keep an eye out as you explore! With future updates, you'll start to find notes scattered throughout the city. These notes will not only give you a peek into what happened to the City itself, but also a chance to learn new blueprints and recipes!

Notes aren't the only thing we'll be adding. With the next update, we'll be introducing new props, new sound effects, and items for you to interact with. We're also restocking the Mozga Emporium, which will now start selling a wider variety of goods!

[h2]Women's Day Sales By WINGS[/h2]
To celebrate the amazing women in our team, City 20 is joining the Women's Day Sales by WINGS here on Steam! From today to March 9th, our game will be 20% off! This is the perfect opportunity to start exploring the City or gifting City 20 to a friend! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883359/741911a9b9c7eabda1010c2d96b9e3dea922ae20.png[/img]

notes.title: January 2025 - Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens, 

As we keep working towards our next big milestone, City 20 just received its first update of 2025! 

The patch introduces two new quests that tie in with and expand the Nostalgic Nurse and the Pen Pal storylines; shedding more light on the lore and backstory of City 20. In addition, we are also deploying dedicated hotfixes to take care of some minor bugs you have reported over the past few weeks.

As usual, don’t forget to join our Discord to see what we’re up to next!

Until then, enjoy the game!
